name: hireflow
description: Hireflow - a production-oriented MERN recruitment platform built phase by phase.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hireflow/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:contracts" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hireflow/contracts && npm run build -w @hireflow/api && npm run build -w @hireflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hireflow/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @hireflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @hireflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hireflow/contracts && npm run test -w @hireflow/api && npm run test -w @hireflow/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
